description: The pending work of every Git repository under your base folders, with safe fixes, and a Worktrees tab that lists every open worktree of your repositories to merge, open a PR or remove it.

settings.label: Repository folders
settings.hint: Git Dash looks for Git repositories in each folder. Every Git Dash panel uses this list.

settings.label: Fetch on refresh
settings.hint: Run git fetch in each repository before it is read, so the behind counts are current. Slower.
